message.content: Pandas belong to the order Carnivora, but their lineage diverged early from other carnivores. Fossil evidence suggests they split from other bear lineages around 20–25 million years ago. Over time, they evolved specialized traits such as a pseudo-thumb for grasping bamboo, which is key to their diet. Their evolutionary path shows a mix of ancestral bear features and unique adaptations that have allowed them to thrive in forested habitats.
